author: Peter
paper: Green, Li & Papanikolaou (2026) — Generative AI Product Displacement Risk (WP)
takeaway: AI-PDR (how digitally-deliverable a firm's products are, scored from 10-K text by an LLM) predicts ~10pp lower CARs when Anthropic's open-source Cowork Plugins launched targeted agents; general model releases (ChatGPT, Opus 4.5) don't reprice it.
best: Sharp identification of *when* the market prices product-displacement risk — only the product-targeting release moves prices, and supply-side shields (moats/regulation) attenuate the effect ~37%.
idea: Cowork Plugins are open-source complements — this is 'commoditize your complement' at the product level. Pair AI-PDR with my OSS-release / Data Power setting: does a platform's open-source AI push transfer value away from high-deliverability complement firms?
